invoices_origin_order_consistent.name: invoices_origin_order_consistent
invoices_origin_order_consistent.value:
("invoices"."origin" = 'MANUAL' and "invoices"."order_id" is null)
        or ("invoices"."origin" = 'ORDER' and "invoices"."order_id" is not null)

invoices_numbering_state_consistent.name: invoices_numbering_state_consistent
invoices_numbering_state_consistent.value:
("invoices"."status" = 'DRAFT' and "invoices"."number" is null and "invoices"."issued_at" is null)
        or ("invoices"."status" in ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'PAID') and "invoices"."number" is not null and "invoices"."issued_at" is not null)
        or ("invoices"."status" = 'VOID' and (("invoices"."number" is null and "invoices"."issued_at" is null)
          or ("invoices"."number" is not null and "invoices"."issued_at" is not null)))

invoices_paid_at_consistent.name: invoices_paid_at_consistent
invoices_paid_at_consistent.value:
("invoices"."status" = 'PAID' and "invoices"."paid_at" is not null)
        or ("invoices"."status" in ('DRAFT', 'PENDING_PAYMENT') and "invoices"."paid_at" is null)
        or "invoices"."status" = 'VOID'

invoices_due_after_issue.name: invoices_due_after_issue
invoices_due_after_issue.value: "invoices"."due_at" is null or ("invoices"."issued_at" is not null and "invoices"."due_at" >= "invoices"."issued_at")

invoices_paid_after_issue.name: invoices_paid_after_issue
invoices_paid_after_issue.value: "invoices"."paid_at" is null or ("invoices"."issued_at" is not null and "invoices"."paid_at" >= "invoices"."issued_at")

carts_closed_at_consistent.name: carts_closed_at_consistent
carts_closed_at_consistent.value:
("carts"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "carts"."closed_at" is null)
        or ("carts"."status" <> 'ACTIVE' and "carts"."closed_at" is not null)

payments_processed_at_consistent.name: payments_processed_at_consistent
payments_processed_at_consistent.value:
("payments"."status" = 'PENDING' and "payments"."processed_at" is null)
        or ("payments"."status" <> 'PENDING' and "payments"."processed_at" is not null)

inventory_movements_reference_consistent.name: inventory_movements_reference_consistent
inventory_movements_reference_consistent.value:
("inventory_movements"."reference_type" is null and "inventory_movements"."reference_id" is null)
        or ("inventory_movements"."reference_type" is not null and "inventory_movements"."reference_id" is not null)
